title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays `nums1` and `nums2` of size `m` and `n` respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays. The overall run time complexity should be O(log (m+n)).

hints.content: Partition both arrays such that left half has (m + n + 1) / 2 elements.
Binary search the partition index on the smaller array.
Check if maxLeft1 <= minRight2 and maxLeft2 <= minRight1. If so, calculate median.

solution.explanation:
Binary search partition on the smaller array ensuring max(left) <= min(right).
Time Complexity: O(log(min(m, n)))
Space Complexity: O(1)
